fields.description: Chevalia Estate 2 is a four and five bedroom villa collection in Grand Polo Club & Resort. Its proposed setting brings homes close to the community’s polo fields, stables, clubhouse and linear parks. The architecture and landscaped approach take their cues from the equestrian character of the wider development.

overview: The project brief places Chevalia Estate 2 around the masterplan’s Green Core, where three polo fields, stables and a clubhouse form the principal equestrian setting. Landscaped routes connect the villa clusters to this wider community. The collection spans smaller four bedroom homes and substantially larger five bedroom layouts, so the bedroom count alone is not enough to compare them. The plans also distinguish space allocated for a pool from a contractual commitment to deliver one.
research.locationNote: Chevalia Estate 2 forms part of Grand Polo Club & Resort in the wider Dubai Investment Park area. Its project brief maps the relationship to The Oasis, Expo City and Al Maktoum International Airport. Published drive times are indicative; confirm actual road access and the chosen plot’s position within the estate.
research.priceNote: The developer’s current price widget shows AED 18,801,888 for its published selection, while the page retains a headline from AED 7.8m. The launch fact sheet lists AED 7.88m for four-bedroom Luxury, AED 10.03m for five-bedroom Ultra Luxury and AED 17.61m for five-bedroom Equestrian Luxury. The lower launch prices are historical, not confirmation of stock at those levels.
research.paymentNote: The launch schedule has 10% booking, seven 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Early dates have passed. Confirm the selected villa’s current offer, already-due amounts and remaining construction-linked payments.
research.handoverNote: June 2029 is the payment sheet’s estimated construction-completion month, also reported by Property Finder. Contractual delivery and the latest developer progress update should be checked.

facts.label: Launch collection and plots
facts.value: 120 villas: 74 four-bedroom Luxury, 24 five-bedroom Ultra Luxury and 22 five-bedroom Equestrian Luxury. Their average plots are 5,794, 6,057 and 9,149 sq ft respectively; these are averages, not a specific plot’s dimensions or remaining stock.

facts.label: Largest reviewed layout
facts.value: Type 5 combines 6,645.20 sq ft suite, 1,336.66 sq ft balcony and 652.94 sq ft carport. Its three-level plan shows a lift, working and show kitchens, separate maid’s and driver’s rooms, study and roof lounge. The drawing labels the swimming pool as provision.
